Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Unix time (number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order book ID
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book. NOTE: Expired Order book IDs may be reused for new instruments.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security short name.

Field.Name: Long Name
Field.Description: Human-readable long name of security.

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN code identifying security.

Field.Name: Financial Product
Field.Description: Values: 0 = Not applicable 1 = Option 2 = Forward 3 = Future 4 = FRA 5 = Cash 6 = Payment 7 = Exchange Rate 8 = Interest Rate Swap 9 = REPO 10 = Synthetic Box Leg/Reference 11 = Standard Combination 12 = Guarantee 13 = OTC General 14 = Equity Warrant 15 = Security Lending 16 = Non deliverable rolling spot 17 = Strip

Field.Name: Trading Currency
Field.Description: Trading currency.

Field.Name: Number of decimals in Price
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals used in price for this order book. NOTE: A value of 256 means that the instrument is traded in fractions (each fraction is 1/256).

Field.Name: Number of decimals in Nominal Value
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals in Nom- inal Value.

Field.Name: Odd Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represent an odd lot for the order book. NOTE: A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book. The document states no data type for this field. Numeric is taken from the Nasdaq Nordic Equities TotalView Itch specification, which types Round Lot Size as Integer.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the quantity that represent a round lot for the issue The document states no data type for this field. Numeric is taken from the Nasdaq Nordic Equities TotalView Itch specification, which types Round Lot Size as Integer.

Field.Name: Block Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represent a block lot for the order book. NOTE: A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book. The document states no data type for this field. Numeric is taken from the Nasdaq Nordic Equities TotalView Itch specification, which types Round Lot Size as Integer.

Field.Name: Nominal Value
Field.Description: Nominal value.

Field.Name: Number of Legs
Field.Description: Number of legs. NOTE: Only applicable for combination instruments.

Field.Name: Underlying Order book ID
Field.Description: Order book ID of underlying instrument. NOTE: Only applicable for underlying instruments.

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: NOTE: Only applicable for derivative instruments.

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Date of expiration. NOTE: Only applicable for derivative instruments.

Field.Name: Number of decimals in Strike Price
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals used in Strike Price for this order book. NOTE: Only applicable for derivative instruments.

Field.Name: Put or Call
Field.Description: Option type. Values: 1 = Call 2 = Put NOTE: A value of 0 indicates that Put or Call is un- defined for the order book.

Field.Name: Notation Date
Field.Description: Notation Date.

Field.Name: First Trading Date and Time
Field.Description: First Trading Date and Time.

Field.Name: Last Trading Date and Time
Field.Description: Last Trading Date and Time.

Field.Name: Country ID
Field.Description: Country Code

Field.Name: Market ID
Field.Description: Market Code.

Field.Name: Physical Delivery
Field.Description: Defines if the order book is physically delivered. 0 = Not applicable 1 = Yes 2 = No

Field.Name: Option Style
Field.Description: Defines the style of option. 0 = Not applicable 1 = American 2 = European 3 = Asian

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Country ID
Field.Description: Country Code

Field.Name: Market ID
Field.Description: Market Code

Field.Name: Market Name
Field.Description: Market Name

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Combination Order book ID
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book. NOTE: Expired Order book IDs may be reused for new instruments.

Field.Name: Leg Order book ID
Field.Description: Order book ID of Leg instrument

Field.Name: Leg Side
Field.Description: Values: B = As Defined C = Opposite

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order book ID
Field.Description: The order book this entry belongs to.

Field.Name: Tick Size
Field.Description: Tick Size for the give price range

Field.Name: Price From
Field.Description: Start of price range for this entry.

Field.Name: Price To
Field.Description: End of price range for this entry. Zero (0) means infinity.

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: The system supports the following event codes on a daily basis: “O” = Start of Messages. Outside of time stamp messages, the start of day message is the first message sent in any trading day. “C” = End of Messages. This is always the last mes- sage sent in any trading day.

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Orderbook ID
Field.Description: Orderbook ID.

Field.Name: Combo Group ID
Field.Description: Used to group combination order book executions and the trades in the constituent order books to- gether.

Field.Name: Trade Type
Field.Description: Values: Trade Types as configured for the exchange.

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Match ID
Field.Description: The Match ID of the execution that was broken. This refers to a Match ID from a previous Trade Message.

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Orderbook ID
Field.Description: Orderbook ID.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The side of quote being requested. Values: “B” = buy quote requested. “S” = sell quote requested. “C” = request for cross “ ” (Space) = Double-sided quote requested

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Requested Quote quantity. Zero means any quanti- ty.

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Orderbook ID
Field.Description: Orderbook ID.

Field.Name: Open Interest
Field.Description: Open interest.

Field.Name: Previous Trading Date
Field.Description: Previous trading date (T-1).

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Price Type
Field.Description: Type of price published. Valid values: “S” = Settlement Price “I” = Indicative “M” = Margin Price

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: If set to MIN_INT (decimal -2147483648), it means that no price is available.

Field.Name: Price Source
Field.Description: “E” = Exchange “T” = Theoretical

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Last Message
Field.Description: Indicates if the message is the final message in a Market by Level update 0 = Not Last Message 1 = Last Message Where Last Message = 0, there will be more mes- sages to follow to complete the Market by Level update. When Last Message = 1, the full Market by Level update will have been received.

Field.Name: Level Update Action
Field.Description: Type of market update action. 0 = New 1 = Change 2 = Delete 3 = Max Depth Where Level Update Action = 3 (Max Depth), the following fields will have a zero (0) value: • Level Update • Entry Type • Price • Quantity.

Field.Name: Max Depth
Field.Description: Maximum number of available price levels.

Field.Name: Level Update
Field.Description: Integer to convey the price level of the bid or offer. 1 is the highest level.

Field.Name: Entry Type
Field.Description: Valid values: B = Buy S = Sell

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Market by Level Price

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Market by Level Quantity

Field.Name: Timestamp – Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Turnover
Field.Description: The number of traded contracts

Field.Name: Best Bid Volume
Field.Description: Total volume of orders in the market on best bid

Field.Name: Best Ask Volume
Field.Description: Total volume of orders in the market on ask bid
